title: Portal access
intro: Choose which contacts can enter this customer's portal.
empty: No one has portal access yet. Invite an existing contact to open the company area.

dialog.title: Invite contact to portal
dialog.linkHint: This link is visible only now. Copy it and share it securely with the contact.
dialog.previewIntro: Check the contact and roles before this customer's first invitation.
dialog.previewNoAreas: Only the company area is currently available. More portal areas will follow.
dialog.previewPrivate: Prices, budgets, internal notes and credentials always stay internal.
dialog.rolesHint: At least one role is required. Changes apply from the next request.
dialog.revokeHint: Access ends immediately. Previous history is retained.

errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.notFound: This portal access record is no longer available. Reload the customer record.
errors.assignmentMissing: This contact is no longer assigned to the customer. Reload the customer record and choose another contact.
errors.invalidRole: A selected portal role is no longer active or does not grant portal access. Check the role selection.
errors.validation: The request could not be saved. Check the contact and roles, then try again.
errors.forbidden: You no longer have permission to manage this customer's portal access.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again and retry.
errors.unavailable: Portal access is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.copy: The link could not be copied. Select and copy it directly.
errors.alreadyActive: This contact already has portal access. Change their roles in the customer record or revoke their access there.
errors.roles: Select at least one active portal role that grants portal access.
errors.conflict: The record changed. Your selection is preserved; check the current details and save again.
errors.preview: Confirm the preview before creating the first invitation.
